import openai


def route(msgs, schema):

        model="gpt-4o-mini",
        messages=msgs,
        functions=[{"name": "get_order", "parameters": schema}],
        function_call="auto",
    )
    call = resp["choices"][0]["message"].get("function_call")
    return json.loads(call["arguments"]) if call else None
